d: the long-reigning cautious Great King of Persia, a soft heavy Achaemenid face with curled beard, gold torc and cidaris, robed in purple-bordered linen, the cautious judge of the peace of Callias
the aged serene King of Kings who survived the Satraps' Revolt, a long white-streaked beard, wise tired eyes, gold diadem and embroidered robe, remembered as the brother of Cyrus the Younger

the harsh reconqueror of Egypt and crusher of the pharaohs' last stand, a cold-eyed clean-featured Achaemenid with short curled beard, plain gold diadem, iron-gray robe, the restoration of the empire's discipline

the Covenant Chain treaty sachem of the Dutch and English alliances, speaker of the eastern door, a weathered Mohawk elder with braided hair, wampum belt across a deerskin robe, wolf-fur mantle and calm watchful gaze

the great organizer sultan of the Seljuk empire's golden age, patron of the Nizamiyya and the reformer of the calendar, a broad-faced Turkic ruler with a full dark beard, jeweled turban with aigrette, silk caftan and fur-lined cloak
